---
title: Add Shop
description: >-
  Expand your store network by entering detailed shop profiles, mapping physical
  addresses, adding contact details, and inputting operation hours for customer
  reference.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1375" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Shop > Add Shop.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="332" height="204" style="width: 332px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Enter shop details and insert images or gallery.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="517" height="374" style="width: 517px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Navigate to Location tab, enter shop location details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="539" height="352" style="width: 539px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
